page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable markdown instructions that agents can share.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a reusable markdown instruction. Create one to share it across agents.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

importModal.subtitle: Preview the extracted SKILL.md. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
